shared: Employee identity anchor before paid debits in cashout and standalone pay; deterministic request replay and atomic ledger/treasury/journal/audit.
differences: Cashout advance intentionally permits negative employee balance; withdrawal and standalone pay limited earned balance.
Cashout requires Open shift and Drawer source; standalone pay excludes Drawer and requires active day.
Cashout account-before-ledger versus standalone ledger-before-account; same employee anchor serializes same-employee path pair, so no automatic deadlock finding.
Correction serializes attendance row then employee ledger range; immutable audit snapshot confirms even zero-delta retry. Poster alone has no transaction/lock.
root_conclusion: Useful shared infrastructure candidate, but one generic business permission/source/shift/eligibility rule would erase intentional financial policy. Full mirrored-code audit remains incomplete.
tests: Provider-backed cross-path concurrency and rollback only on authorized isolated DB; NOT_EXECUTED.
